answer: Correlated-spending discounts. A sybil farm's N identities share one operator's brain, so their on-chain spending shows it: same suppliers, same cadence, same amounts — an oasis of identical footprints in a harbor of noisy, idiosyncratic honest spending. The protocol computes pairwise expenditure similarity over a rolling window and haircuts emission for tightly correlated clusters. A head caught on the ledge between automation and evasion forces the operator's hand: hand-crafting a distinct economic life per head costs real per-identity effort — exactly the honest cost.
